description: This file contains functions and classes related to fetching, processing, and caching GitHub user profile insights, including computing total stars, top languages, and managing cached profiles in a database, with integration to external GitHub API via a client.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Database model representing a GitHub user profile, including fields like username, bio, avatar URL, followers, following, total stars, top languages, and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: int _compute_total_stars(repos: list[dict])
methods.description: Calculates the total number of stars across a list of repositories.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] _compute_top_languages(repos: list[dict])
methods.description: Computes the most common programming languages across repositories.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,Any],Dict[str,Optional[str]]] get_profile_insights( session: AsyncSession, username: str )
methods.description: Main asynchronous function to retrieve GitHub profile insights, utilizing cache when available, or fetching fresh data and updating the database.
